settings.title: Everything about fit, fabric, delivery and returns in one place.

settings.editor: Our socks come in three sizes, knitted with a little stretch so they hug the foot and keep their shape wash after wash. Tees are a relaxed unisex fit.

settings.title: The cuff sits above the ankle and below the calf, and stays put without pinching.
Measure heel to longest toe and use the foot-length column. If you’re between sizes, size up.
Choose your usual size, or size down for a closer fit. Sizes XS to XL.
Soft, breathable cotton with a little stretch for comfort and recovery.
Messages and motifs are knitted into the fabric, so they soften with the sock instead of fading.
Extra strength where socks wear first, so every pair lasts longer.
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle with like colours. Turn inside out first to protect the knitted messages.
Line dry in the shade or dry flat. Skip the tumble dryer.
No bleach, no fabric softener, no ironing.
Cotton softens over the first few washes. A little surface fluff early on is normal and washes out.

settings.editor: Every order is packed by hand in Australia and sent with Australia Post within one to two business days, with tracking.

settings.title: Available countries and costs are shown at checkout.

settings.editor: Estimates are business days after dispatch. International orders may attract local import duties or taxes, payable by the recipient.
Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law. Our 30-day promise is an extra benefit on top of them.

settings.title: Email us within 30 days with your order number and a photo. We’ll send a new pair at no cost.
Email us within 30 days to swap for another colour or size. You cover return postage; we cover the replacement.
For hygiene reasons, worn socks can’t be returned or exchanged for change of mind.
How to start a return or exchange
Write to hello@blessmysocks.com with your order number, the item and a photo if it’s faulty.
Within one to two business days, with the return address for exchanges.
Faulty pairs are re-sent straight away. Exchanges ship once your parcel reaches us.
